mentions.name: Mimic Marketer
mentions.description: A marketing test tool that lets users define personas and test marketing content against them to see how different personas would interact with the copy. Current features include defining basic personas and testing them against two types of copy, plus a tool that grades email subject lines and bodies against a generic persona, assessing the likelihood of user interaction with the content.
mentions.audience: Marketers and business owners testing marketing copy and email content
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on https://mimicmarketer.com It allows you to define different personas that you can then test marketing on. This allows you to see how different personas will interact with your marketing. Currently, it has a feature that allows you to define basic personas and test them against two types of copy, as well as a tool that grades your email subject lines and bodies against a generic persona, assessing the likelihood of user interaction with the content.
